paras: The Kungwe apalis (Apalis argentea) is a species in the family Cisticolidae.  It was previously considered it to be a subspecies of the buff-throated apalis.  It is found in Burundi, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Rwanda, and Tanzania.
Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical dry forest and subtropical or tropical moist montane forest.
It is threatened by habitat loss.
